Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

scope_change_reason: The assigned rank-three relation escape investigation produced a sharp arbitrary-width scalar-pool normal form and a counterexample to a four-dimensional-core assumption, rather than a native supplier or a completed saving word.
actual_scope: Prove the general edge-quotient image bound, the sharp two-edge five-dimensional normal form, and cancellation of its bridge block in every diagonal monomial word with at most three exponent relations.
bottleneck_link: The two-relation no-saving theorem leaves three exponent relations as the first possible escape. This result identifies a necessary five-dimensional search case; it gives no BIT budget change.
stop_rule: Stop at the first proved sharp structural result; do not present the bounded hexagon search failure as a rank bound or launch broad larger-word enumeration.
